subject.title: fix(auth): bind OAuth and sessions to immutable identity

question: Should upgrades fail closed for every legacy email-owned durable record until an operator recreates it, or should Crabbox provide a narrowly scoped, auditable administrator migration path to immutable GitHub owners?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes existing access and ownership semantics; source tests can validate mechanics but cannot determine the supported operational recovery contract for deployed records.

options.title: Add an auditable migration path
options.body: Provide a documented, explicit administrator-operated mapping or migration flow to immutable GitHub owners, with upgrade coverage that never transfers access based only on a mutable email.

options.title: Keep recreation-only recovery
options.body: Accept fail-closed upgrades and require operators to recreate affected sessions and durable records, with prominent operational guidance and release communication.

options.title: Pause the migration
options.body: Defer the durable-owner cutover until maintainers choose and resource a supported recovery experience.

recommendation.title: Add an auditable migration path
recommendation.body: Provide a documented, explicit administrator-operated mapping or migration flow to immutable GitHub owners, with upgrade coverage that never transfers access based only on a mutable email.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent commits on the branch directly define the immutable-admin and migration behavior that requires product and operational ownership.
